caption: Vector rotate: each pixel's direction turned about the vertical axis by a clock - the noise pattern turns round the cube
why: Turning a whole 3-D pattern - spinning it round the cube, tumbling it - means turning the direction or position it is drawn from. Vector rotate turns a vector about any axis by a number of turns: one node, and the whole picture rotates.
Its neighbours: Rotate turns a 2-D pair about the origin; Transform moves and zooms flat coordinates; Mirror fold reflects; Vector rotate turns in 3-D.
steps: **axis** is (0, 0, 1): straight up. **turns** comes from a clock (**Time** times 0.08): one full turn every twelve and a half seconds.

The turned direction is split (**Vector split**) into a **Noise**'s x, y and z (scale 2.5): the noise pattern is drawn on the turned directions, so it turns round the cube - the lid spins, the walls slide past.
The noise picks a colour from the **Palette**.

try.label: Tumble
try.text: axis (1, 0, 0): the turn is about a horizontal axis - the pattern rolls over the top and under.

try.label: Diagonal
try.text: axis (1, 1, 1): turning about the cube's corner-to-corner line - every face moves.
